If Instagram lists only an animated WebP or an MP4 for it, you get that file instead, and an MP4 goes in Movies/Instagram like a video. It can also add a GIF reply to a comment with a GIF, sending that same GIF back as your reply. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Save profile picture
patches_modified.description: Adds Save profile picture, View profile picture, Copy username and Copy bio to the menu on someone's profile. View opens the picture full screen and lets you zoom. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Saved on your profile
patches_modified.description: Adds a bookmark to the tabs on your own profile, beside posts, reels and tagged, that opens Saved. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles, then restart Instagram.

patches_modified.name: See who a story mentions
patches_modified.description: Adds a small label in a story's header showing how many accounts it mentions. Tap it for a list and tap an account to open their profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Seek bar on feed videos
patches_modified.description: Shows a bar along the bottom of the video playing in your feed that you can drag to jump to any point in it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed. Another switch there adds a small button on the video that shows or hides the bar, and a choice under it makes the bar see-through or puts it on frosted glass.

patches_modified.name: Seek bar on stories
patches_modified.description: Shows a bar near the bottom of a video story that you can drag to jump to any point in the video. Photos don't get one. A choice under it makes the bar see-through or puts it on frosted glass. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Show a post's exact time
patches_modified.description: Shows the date and time a post went up, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, instead of how long ago. It does the same for comments. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Show a reel's exact time
patches_modified.description: Adds the date and time a reel was posted under the author's name, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, with the seconds or how long ago (1d 2h 5m ago) if you want them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Show a story's exact time
patches_modified.description: Shows the date and time a story was posted, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, instead of how long ago. A choice under the switch can show the time left instead. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Show all recent searches
patches_modified.description: Lists every recent search under the search bar instead of the first few. See all and the x on each row work as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Explore.

patches_modified.name: Show hidden like counts
patches_modified.description: Shows how many likes a post or reel has when its owner hid the count, as long as Instagram's server still sends the number. If it doesn't, nothing changes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Show if a profile follows you
patches_modified.description: Adds Follows you or Doesn't follow you beside the name on someone's profile. Other switches add a chip and mark accounts on your Following list that don't follow you back, and Recent unfollowers shows who left your Followers list, with a Follower history of who left, came back or is new. The chip is blue for Follows you, green for Following each other and red for Doesn't follow you, and it can go small under the profile picture. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches_modified.name: Show when someone was last active
patches_modified.description: Shows the exact time someone was last on, like Active at 3:42 PM, in your messages and in a chat, instead of Active 3h ago. Active now stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Skip the ad data reminder
patches_modified.description: Stops Instagram's reminder to review whether it can process your data for ads from opening by itself. Your ad choice doesn't change and nothing is answered for you. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches_modified.name: Skip the collections tray
patches_modified.description: Saving a post or reel shows Instagram's Saved message instead of the tray that asks you to start a collection. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Skip the contacts and location popups
patches_modified.description: Stops the screens asking you to sync your contacts and turn on location services from opening each time Instagram starts. Nothing else is skipped. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches_modified.name: Smooth story opening
patches_modified.description: Opens a story from the stories row with a slower, gentler zoom instead of Instagram's quick spring. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Speed button on stories
patches_modified.description: Puts a speed button at the top of a video story. Tap it to play the story at 1.5x or 2x, and later video stories keep that speed. Photos and ads play as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Spoof location
patches_modified.description: Tells Instagram your phone is at a place you pick, for the location sticker, nearby places and maps. Photos keep their own places. You need to pick a place too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches_modified.name: Start Home on Following
patches_modified.description: Opens Home on posts from accounts you follow instead of For you. A second switch removes For you from Home, and a third keeps Instagram's logo at the top of Home in place of the feed's name. A fourth, Fall back to Following, opens Home on Following for an account whose For you brings only suggested posts, unless you picked a feed. A fifth, Mix in Following, shows a page of posts from accounts you follow after each page of For you. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Start feed videos with sound
patches_modified.description: Starts the first video on Home with its sound on, the same as tapping the video's speaker. Your phone's ringer and volume still count. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Start on x86 devices
patches_modified.description: Stops Instagram from crashing or freezing on x86 devices that run its code through a translator, such as some Chromebooks and emulators. Phones and tablets with arm chips run it as before. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Start reels with sound
patches_modified.description: A reel you open from a post on Home plays with sound, and Home is muted again when you go back. Your phone's ringer and volume still count. A separate switch, Start reels muted, starts every reel silent instead. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Start stories with sound
patches_modified.description: Opens stories with their sound on, the same as tapping Instagram's speaker. Your phone's ringer and volume still count. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Stop Reels scrolling
patches_modified.description: Stops a swipe in Reels from moving to the next reel, so you stay on the one you opened. A second switch stops swiping after as many reels as you pick, for as long as you pick, and Take a scroll break covers Home, Reels and Explore for 5 minutes after the time you pick. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Stop Story auto-advance
patches_modified.description: Keeps each story on screen until you tap or swipe. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Stop background wake-ups
patches_modified.description: Stops two alarms that wake your phone while Instagram is in the background. One goes off every minute or two only to note that Instagram is still running, and the other wakes it five minutes later to upload usage events. Messages and notifications still arrive. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Battery.

patches_modified.name: Stop swipe to create
patches_modified.description: Stops a sideways swipe on Home from opening the camera. The + button still opens it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Stop swipe up to reply
patches_modified.description: Stops a swipe up on someone's story from opening the reply box and its reactions. Tapping Send message still replies. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Stop swiping between tabs
patches_modified.description: Stops a sideways swipe from moving between Home, Reels and the other main tabs. Tapping the tab bar still works. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Stop videos looping
patches_modified.description: Feed videos and reels stop at their last frame instead of playing again. Reels still loop while auto scroll is on, so it can move on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Stories priority
patches_modified.description: Puts the accounts on your list first in the stories row at the top of Home while they have a story you haven't watched. Starts off. Turn it on and type the accounts in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Story ring size
patches_modified.description: Draws the rings in the stories row at the top of Home smaller, so more fit on screen, or larger, and the ring of a story you haven't watched in a color you pick. Nothing changes until you pick a size or a color. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Story text fonts
patches_modified.description: Adds fonts you pick from your phone (.ttf or .otf files) to the story text editor alongside Instagram's own fonts, and can draw the emoji in story text from an emoji font file you pick. Starts off. Set both up in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Swipe left to open the profile
patches_modified.description: Makes a left swipe on a reel open the profile of the person who posted it, like Instagram used to. Tap Friends at the top to reach your friends' reels. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Swipe through a chat's reels
patches_modified.description: Swiping up on a reel you opened from a chat goes through the other reels shared in that chat before any suggested reels, can stop after them and can leave out the ones you sent. All start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_modified.name: Tab bar layout
patches_modified.description: Lets you keep the newer tab bar, where you swipe between every tab, or the classic one, instead of the one Instagram picks for your account. Starts on Instagram's choice. Pick one in HushGram settings > Tab bar.

patches_modified.name: Tap a feed video to pause it
patches_modified.description: A tap on the video playing in a feed pauses it in place instead of opening it in Reels, and another tap plays it again. Ads keep Instagram's own tap. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Tap to play
patches_modified.description: Makes videos, reels and stories wait for your tap instead of starting by themselves, like Instagram does when it saves mobile data. A choice under the switch can leave Reels out or hold only Reels. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Thicker story progress bar
patches_modified.description: Draws the progress bar along the top of a story twice or three times as thick. Its segments and timing stay as they were. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Turn off HDR brightness boosts
patches_modified.description: Stops HDR photos and reels from making the screen brighter than everything else. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Turn off double tap to like
patches_modified.description: Stops a double tap on a post or reel from liking it, and the heart doesn't show. The Like button still works. Separate switches cover posts, reels, comments and chat messages. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Upload stories at full quality
patches_modified.description: Sends the video stories you post at 1080p and a higher bitrate, as Instagram does with its own Upload at highest quality setting on. Two choices under it can cover posts and reels too and ask for a bitrate up to 50 Mbps. Instagram still shrinks story videos to 720p on its servers, so viewers see a small difference. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Use the highest refresh rate
patches_modified.description: Asks Android to run Instagram at your screen's fastest refresh rate, at the same resolution, so scrolling looks smoother on a 90 or 120 Hz phone. Some phones keep their own limit for apps. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches_modified.name: View DM photos and videos anonymously
patches_modified.description: Holds back the Opened notice for view once photos and videos in messages, so the sender doesn't see you opened them. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches_modified.name: View live anonymously
patches_modified.description: Keeps you off the viewer list of the lives you watch, so the host isn't told you're there. Your own lives still count their viewers. An optional eye button at the top of a live puts you on that one's list. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: View stories anonymously
patches_modified.description: Keeps you off the viewer list of the stories you watch. Replying or reacting still shows you. An optional Mark as seen button lets you choose. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Proxy
patches_modified.description: Routes all of the app's traffic through your HTTP, HTTPS or SOCKS5 proxy, with optional username and password. patches_added.description: For phones that run microG-RE instead of Google Play services. Facebook asks microG-RE for its push notifications, and microG-RE gets the signature of Meta's own Facebook for the Google services that check one. It isn't selected by default because Facebook then stops asking Google Play services, so a phone without microG-RE gets no push notifications. Turn on Expert mode in Manager to pick it. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.description: Adds Hushfacebook settings to Facebook, where you turn features on or off, pause Hushfacebook and back up your choices. To open them, long-press the Facebook logo at the top of your feed, the title at the top of another tab, or Facebook's app icon. Its App name option shows a name you pick under the icon, and Icon style can make the icon white on black or black on white. Other patches need it, so keep it selected.

patches_added.name: Hide pictures on the Blocked list
patches_added.description: Hides people's profile pictures on the list of people you've blocked, under Privacy and safety. Their names and Unblock stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Allow chat bubbles
patches_modified.description: Lets you pick Stock, Chat heads or Android bubbles for floating chats. Needs Android 11 or newer. Chat heads also needs Messenger's own Chat heads switch, and Android bubbles need Messenger's bubbles allowed in Android's notification settings. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Allow screenshots
patches_modified.description: Lets you screenshot protected chat media, such as view-once photos and Quicksnap, and stops screenshot notices. It doesn't add replay or saving. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Android Auto messages
patches_modified.description: Lets Android Auto read your Messenger messages out loud and send the replies you speak, through its own messaging screen. Android Auto only shows apps installed from the Play Store. Unknown sources in its developer settings opens that up on a desktop head unit, and a real car can still leave Messenger out. Playing a message aloud marks the chat read and shows Seen, even with Hide read receipts on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Ask before a call
patches_modified.description: Tapping the audio or video call button in a chat's top bar asks first, so a stray tap doesn't ring anyone. Call starts it, Cancel doesn't. Calls coming in aren't affected. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Auto reply
patches_modified.description: Answers messages with replies you write in HushMessenger settings, when they have words you pick or any message at all. Replies go out through Messenger's own notification reply, encrypted chats too, at most once every five minutes per chat. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Bold and italic text
patches_modified.description: Adds Bold and Italic to the menu that shows when you select words you typed. They're special Unicode letters, so they show on any phone, but screen readers may read them oddly. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Clone install under another package name
patches_modified.description: Installs a second copy of Messenger beside the first, with its own app name. Push notifications may not reach the copy. Pick it in Morphe Manager's Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Custom launcher icon
patches_modified.description: Makes Messenger's home screen icon white on black or black on white. Pick it and its style in Morphe Manager's Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Custom new-message sound
patches_modified.description: Replaces Messenger's new-message sound with an .ogg, .mp3, .m4a or .wav file (1 MB or less) that you choose. Pick it in Morphe Manager's Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Fix videos that won't send
patches_modified.description: Messenger stops two kinds of video with "Unable to send". One is a video whose only sound is xHE-AAC, which Facebook and Instagram now use. The other is a Samsung screen recording whose recorder tag Messenger's media check rejects. Whether you share one into Messenger from another app or pick it in a chat, the sound is converted to regular AAC, or the tag is dropped, so it sends. The picture isn't touched. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: GmsCore support
patches_modified.description: Gets Messenger's push notifications through microG-RE instead of Google Play services. It also gives microG-RE the signature of Meta's own Messenger for the Google services that check one. Only for phones with microG-RE installed, since Messenger stops asking Google Play services. Pick it in Morphe Manager's Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Hide AI sticker tools
patches_modified.description: Hides the Generate and Generate AI sticker buttons, the AI sticker tab and AI sticker suggestions. Custom and music stickers in the Generate menu go with it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Chat Moments
patches_modified.description: Hides Chat Moments in the menu. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Facebook shortcuts
patches_modified.description: Hides Facebook buttons, profile and sharing shortcuts, and the Also from Meta and Subscriptions sections in the Menu tab. Handy if you only use Messenger. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Mark as read
patches_modified.description: Hides Mark as read in the menu you get when you press and hold a chat in your chat list, so you can't mark a chat read by accident. Mark as unread stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Meta AI
patches_modified.description: Hides the Meta AI floating button, toolbar button, tab and menu entries, plus AI in search and in @ suggestions. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Notifications tab
patches_modified.description: Hides the Notifications tab in the bar at the bottom. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide People You May Know
patches_modified.description: Hides suggested people in chats, search and stories, and on the People and Notifications tabs, so you only see people you know. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide People tab
patches_modified.description: Hides the People tab in the bar at the bottom. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Reels badge
patches_modified.description: Hides the Reels notification badge. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Your story when sharing
patches_modified.description: When you share a photo, video or link into Messenger from another app, the Send to list no longer offers Your story, so a tap on Add can't post it by mistake. Your chats and groups are still there. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide ad banners in business chats
patches_modified.description: In a chat you started from a business's ad, hides the banner that shows that ad. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide avatar stickers
patches_modified.description: Hides the avatar tab in the sticker keyboard. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide business reply suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides suggested replies in conversations with businesses. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide business typing suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides business suggestions that pop up as you type. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide call buttons
patches_modified.description: Takes the audio and video call buttons out of a chat's top bar, so you can't tap one by accident. Calls still ring, and you can still join one that's going. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide chat promotions
patches_modified.description: Hides promotion banners inside conversations. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide event prompts
patches_modified.description: Hides event promotion prompts inside chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide friend request cards
patches_modified.description: Hides friend request cards in your chat list so they stop taking up room. It doesn't accept or decline anyone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide growth prompts
patches_modified.description: Hides prompts to add more people, the tip sheets in notes (like Make my notes public), and the Share your own story card after someone else's stories. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox promotions
patches_modified.description: Hides promotion banners in your chat list. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox tabs
patches_modified.description: Hides the All, Unread and Groups tabs above your chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide joined community chats
patches_modified.description: Hides the community chats you joined from your main chat list. Search and community folders still show them. Messages and unread counts don't change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide read receipts
patches_modified.description: Opening a chat no longer tells people you read their message, and the chat stays unread on this phone. Marking it read yourself or replying in it marks it read and shows Seen, like Messenger does. Group chats aren't tested. Messenger's own Read receipts setting under Privacy & safety marks chats read without showing Seen. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide stories and notes
patches_modified.description: Hides the row of stories and notes above your chats, and the story rings around profile pictures. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide tab badges
patches_modified.description: Hides the red dots and counts on the tabs at the bottom and on the Facebook button at the top. Turn on Keep for any you still want. Restart Messenger to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Instants button
patches_modified.description: Hides the + button that slides in at the right edge of your chat list and the one under your chat heads. Both open Instants. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide the recent photo card
patches_modified.description: Stops the card above the message box that offers to send the screenshot, photo or video you just took. You can still send it from the gallery. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide typing indicator
patches_modified.description: Stops Messenger from showing others when you're typing, even in end-to-end encrypted chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hold stories at the end
patches_modified.description: Keeps a story on screen when it ends instead of moving on to the next one, so you go on with a tap or a swipe. Photos and videos both wait, and the last story stays open until you close it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Ignore the swipe up for disappearing messages
patches_modified.description: Swiping up at the bottom of a chat no longer turns on disappearing messages, so a scroll can't set the timer by accident. You can still change it in the chat's settings. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Install beside Meta apps
patches_modified.description: Lets your patched Messenger install next to Facebook and other Meta apps. Without it, the apps can clash over shared permissions and the install can stop at a blank screen. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Jump to the first message or a date
patches_modified.description: Long press a chat's name at the top of the chat to jump to its first message or to a day you pick. Messenger loads a chat a page at a time, so it scrolls back with a count on screen until it gets there, and Cancel stops it. It can only go as far back as Messenger can load. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Keep a message log
patches_modified.description: Saves each message when its notification arrives, so you can still read it if it's unsent, and marks the ones that were. Works in end-to-end encrypted chats too. Stays on your phone. A clock next to the new message button in Chats can open the log too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Keep chat pop-ups
patches_modified.description: Messenger can turn off message pop-ups for good when it expects a chat head to show. This stops that and brings them back on a phone where it already happened, unless you lowered them yourself in Android's settings or picked Chat heads under Allow chat bubbles.

patches_modified.name: Keep emoji search on emoji
patches_modified.description: Typing while the emoji keyboard is open no longer jumps to sticker search. The keyboard stays on emoji. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Keep the search bar
patches_modified.description: Brings back the search bar at the top of your chat list when Messenger has swapped it for a search icon. Restart Messenger after changing it. If Messenger never gave you the icon, nothing changes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Keep unsent messages
patches_modified.description: Keeps messages on screen after someone unsends them, in chats where it works. In end-to-end encrypted chats the message stays in its notification instead, since the chat itself can't keep it. Group chats aren't tested. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Mark as read button
patches_modified.description: Puts Messenger's Mark as read icon in a chat's top bar while Hide read receipts is on. Opening the chat still sends nothing, and a tap on the icon sends Seen and marks the chat read. When the bar is full it takes the place of the chat details button (tapping the chat's name opens the same page), or of another button that isn't for calls when a chat doesn't have one, so the call buttons stay put. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Material You theme
patches_modified.description: Colors Messenger's dark mode with your wallpaper colors on Android 12 and newer, and a fixed blue on Android 11. Turn on dark mode in Messenger first. Light mode keeps its colors unless you turn on Light mode accent. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Open settings from menu
patches_modified.description: Adds a HushMessenger entry to Messenger's Menu tab and side menu, and makes a long press on the Messenger logo at the top of Chats or on the Menu tab's title open these settings too. Works as soon as you patch it in. The settings App tab can turn off each way in, as long as one stays on.

patches_modified.name: Open web links externally
patches_modified.description: Opens web links (http and https) in your default browser instead of inside Messenger. Other link types work as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Open your gallery app
patches_modified.description: The gallery button in a chat opens your phone's own gallery app. One photo or video opens in Messenger's editor for that chat, ready to send. Pick several and Messenger's Send to sheet opens with all of them and that chat at the top. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Pin more chats
patches_modified.description: Lets you pin chats past Messenger's limit and puts Pin back on chats that don't offer it. Pins past the limit stay on this phone, so they won't show on your other devices. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Put gallery picks in the chat
patches_modified.description: With Open your gallery app on, what you pick goes into the chat's message box the way Messenger's own gallery puts it there, instead of the editor or the Send to sheet. Nothing goes out until you tap Send. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Quiet incoming calls
patches_modified.description: Calls still come in, but Messenger doesn't ring, vibrate or pop the call up over your screen. The call waits in the notification shade with Answer and Decline. A call you miss still shows in the chat. Only chosen chats keeps this to the chats you pick, and every other call rings. If the Facebook app is on your phone, it can still ring for the same call. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Record calls
patches_modified.description: Adds a Record button over Messenger during a call. The call goes into one sound file in Recordings/Messenger Calls on your phone (Music/Messenger Calls on Android 10 and 11). While it's on, calls use Android's regular audio path instead of Messenger's own, and Messenger needs a restart after you change it. Messenger doesn't tell the other people, and recording laws differ from place to place, so get everyone's OK first. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Restore old emoji drawer
patches_modified.description: Turns off Meta's redesigned emoji keyboard, so you keep the earlier layout. Restart Messenger after changing it. If Meta never gave you the redesign, nothing changes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Restore screens on re-signed builds
patches_modified.description: Patching and signing Messenger yourself can break some of its screens. This makes Messenger's signature check pass again, including for a Facebook you patched with the same key, and lets Threads and Instagram video links open in a Threads or Instagram you patched yourself. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Save any story
patches_modified.description: Adds Save to the More options menu on other people's stories, so you can keep their photo or video on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Save button for voice messages
patches_modified.description: Adds Save voice message to the menu you get by holding a voice message, for saving just that one. It goes in the same folder as Save voice messages you play, and that switch can stay off. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Save voice messages you play
patches_modified.description: Each voice message you play is also saved to Recordings/Messenger (Music/Messenger on Android 10 and 11), so your file manager and other players can open it. Playing it again doesn't save another copy. Needs Android 10 or newer. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Search saved messages
patches_modified.description: Adds a button to a chat's search results that searches the messages saved on this phone, for old chats Messenger's own search finds nothing in. It works in chats that aren't end-to-end encrypted, and it can only find what the phone has loaded. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Send photos at original quality
patches_modified.description: With HD on, sends a JPEG photo at its full size instead of Messenger's smaller copy, so it stays sharp. Location is still removed. Photos over 20 MB are still made smaller. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Send videos without re-encoding
patches_modified.description: Sends a video as the original file instead of a recompressed copy, when Messenger allows it. Videos over 25 MB, edited videos and some formats are still compressed. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Slide chats in and out
patches_modified.description: Slides a chat in from the side when you open it and back out when you go back. Chat heads and bubbles keep their own animations. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Spoof package version
patches_modified.description: Gives Messenger a high version number so the Play Store stops offering Meta's updates. Messenger may report it to Meta. Going back means uninstalling first, which erases its data. Pick it in Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Square profile pictures
patches_modified.description: Shows profile pictures as squares instead of circles, or as rounded squares with Round the corners on. Restart Messenger after changing it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Stop ad attribution uploads
patches_modified.description: Stops the job that reads your phone's advertising ID and sends it to Meta with your ad tracking setting. The ID itself doesn't change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Stop analytics uploads

patches_modified.name: Stop inbox and ad link logging
patches_modified.description: Stops two reports Messenger logs. One says which part of your chat list was on screen, which Messenger files under inbox ads. The other says which ad brought you in when a link from an ad opens a chat. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Stop live connection logging

patches_modified.name: Stop nearby scans

patches_modified.name: Unlock app icons
patches_modified.description: Lets you pick any icon in Messenger's App icon setting without a subscription. Messenger still decides whether that setting shows for your account. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Unlock app themes
patches_modified.description: Lets you pick any theme in Messenger's Theme setting without a subscription, so light mode can get a color too. Messenger still decides which themes it offers your account. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Use system emoji

patches_modified.name: Use the phone's camera app
patches_modified.description: The camera button in a chat opens your phone's own camera app. The photo then opens in Messenger's editor, ready to send. Photos only. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Use your own font
patches_modified.description: Shows Messenger's text in your phone's font instead of Meta's, or in a .ttf or .otf file you pick in HushMessenger settings. Emoji don't change. Restart Messenger after changing it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: View stories anonymously
patches_modified.description: Opens other people's stories without adding you to their viewer list. Messenger still marks them as seen on your side. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Your own home header
patches_modified.description: Puts words or a picture of your own at the top of the chat list in place of Messenger's wordmark. Type the words or pick the picture in HushMessenger settings. With neither, the wordmark stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Hide pictures on the Blocked list
patches_added.description: Hides people's profile pictures on the list of people you've blocked, under Privacy and safety. Their names and Unblock stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Allow chat bubbles
patches_modified.description: Lets you pick Stock, Chat heads or Android bubbles for floating chats. Needs Android 11 or newer. Chat heads also needs Messenger's own Chat heads switch, and Android bubbles need Messenger's bubbles allowed in Android's notification settings. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Allow screenshots
patches_modified.description: Lets you screenshot protected chat media, such as view-once photos and Quicksnap, and stops screenshot notices. It doesn't add replay or saving. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Android Auto messages
patches_modified.description: Lets Android Auto read your Messenger messages out loud and send the replies you speak, through its own messaging screen. Android Auto only shows apps installed from the Play Store. Unknown sources in its developer settings opens that up on a desktop head unit, and a real car can still leave Messenger out. Playing a message aloud marks the chat read and shows Seen, even with Hide read receipts on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Ask before a call
patches_modified.description: Tapping the audio or video call button in a chat's top bar asks first, so a stray tap doesn't ring anyone. Call starts it, Cancel doesn't. Calls coming in aren't affected. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Auto reply
patches_modified.description: Answers messages with replies you write in HushMessenger settings, when they have words you pick or any message at all. Replies go out through Messenger's own notification reply, encrypted chats too, at most once every five minutes per chat. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Bold and italic text
patches_modified.description: Adds Bold and Italic to the menu that shows when you select words you typed. They're special Unicode letters, so they show on any phone, but screen readers may read them oddly. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Clone install under another package name
patches_modified.description: Installs a second copy of Messenger beside the first, with its own app name. Push notifications may not reach the copy. Pick it in Morphe Manager's Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Custom launcher icon
patches_modified.description: Makes Messenger's home screen icon white on black or black on white. Pick it and its style in Morphe Manager's Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Custom new-message sound
patches_modified.description: Replaces Messenger's new-message sound with an .ogg, .mp3, .m4a or .wav file (1 MB or less) that you choose. Pick it in Morphe Manager's Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Fix videos that won't send
patches_modified.description: Messenger stops two kinds of video with "Unable to send". One is a video whose only sound is xHE-AAC, which Facebook and Instagram now use. The other is a Samsung screen recording whose recorder tag Messenger's media check rejects. Whether you share one into Messenger from another app or pick it in a chat, the sound is converted to regular AAC, or the tag is dropped, so it sends. The picture isn't touched. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: GmsCore support
patches_modified.description: Gets Messenger's push notifications through microG-RE instead of Google Play services. It also gives microG-RE the signature of Meta's own Messenger for the Google services that check one. Only for phones with microG-RE installed, since Messenger stops asking Google Play services. Pick it in Morphe Manager's Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Hide AI sticker tools
patches_modified.description: Hides the Generate and Generate AI sticker buttons, the AI sticker tab and AI sticker suggestions. Custom and music stickers in the Generate menu go with it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Chat Moments
patches_modified.description: Hides Chat Moments in the menu. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Facebook shortcuts
patches_modified.description: Hides Facebook buttons, profile and sharing shortcuts, and the Also from Meta and Subscriptions sections in the Menu tab. Handy if you only use Messenger. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Mark as read
patches_modified.description: Hides Mark as read in the menu you get when you press and hold a chat in your chat list, so you can't mark a chat read by accident. Mark as unread stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Meta AI
patches_modified.description: Hides the Meta AI floating button, toolbar button, tab and menu entries, plus AI in search and in @ suggestions. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Notifications tab
patches_modified.description: Hides the Notifications tab in the bar at the bottom. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide People You May Know
patches_modified.description: Hides suggested people in chats, search and stories, and on the People and Notifications tabs, so you only see people you know. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide People tab
patches_modified.description: Hides the People tab in the bar at the bottom. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Reels badge
patches_modified.description: Hides the Reels notification badge. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Your story when sharing
patches_modified.description: When you share a photo, video or link into Messenger from another app, the Send to list no longer offers Your story, so a tap on Add can't post it by mistake. Your chats and groups are still there. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide ad banners in business chats
patches_modified.description: In a chat you started from a business's ad, hides the banner that shows that ad. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide avatar stickers
patches_modified.description: Hides the avatar tab in the sticker keyboard. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide business reply suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides suggested replies in conversations with businesses. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide business typing suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides business suggestions that pop up as you type. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide call buttons
patches_modified.description: Takes the audio and video call buttons out of a chat's top bar, so you can't tap one by accident. Calls still ring, and you can still join one that's going. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide chat promotions
patches_modified.description: Hides promotion banners inside conversations. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide event prompts
patches_modified.description: Hides event promotion prompts inside chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide friend request cards
patches_modified.description: Hides friend request cards in your chat list so they stop taking up room. It doesn't accept or decline anyone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide growth prompts
patches_modified.description: Hides prompts to add more people, the tip sheets in notes (like Make my notes public), and the Share your own story card after someone else's stories. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox promotions
patches_modified.description: Hides promotion banners in your chat list. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox tabs
patches_modified.description: Hides the All, Unread and Groups tabs above your chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide joined community chats
patches_modified.description: Hides the community chats you joined from your main chat list. Search and community folders still show them. Messages and unread counts don't change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide stories and notes
patches_modified.description: Hides the row of stories and notes above your chats, and the story rings around profile pictures. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide tab badges
patches_modified.description: Hides the red dots and counts on the tabs at the bottom and on the Facebook button at the top. Turn on Keep for any you still want. Restart Messenger to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Instants button
patches_modified.description: Hides the + button that slides in at the right edge of your chat list and the one under your chat heads. Both open Instants. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide the recent photo card
patches_modified.description: Stops the card above the message box that offers to send the screenshot, photo or video you just took. You can still send it from the gallery. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide typing indicator
patches_modified.description: Stops Messenger from showing others when you're typing, even in end-to-end encrypted chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hold stories at the end
patches_modified.description: Keeps a story on screen when it ends instead of moving on to the next one, so you go on with a tap or a swipe. Photos and videos both wait, and the last story stays open until you close it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Ignore the swipe up for disappearing messages

patches_modified.name: Install beside Meta apps
patches_modified.description: Lets your patched Messenger install next to Facebook and other Meta apps. Without it, the apps can clash over shared permissions and the install can stop at a blank screen. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Jump to the first message or a date
patches_modified.description: Long press a chat's name at the top of the chat to jump to its first message or to a day you pick. Messenger loads a chat a page at a time, so it scrolls back with a count on screen until it gets there, and Cancel stops it. It can only go as far back as Messenger can load. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Keep a message log
patches_modified.description: Saves each message when its notification arrives, so you can still read it if it's unsent, and marks the ones that were. Works in end-to-end encrypted chats too. patches_modified.name: Keep chat pop-ups

patches_modified.name: Keep emoji search on emoji
patches_modified.description: Typing while the emoji keyboard is open no longer jumps to sticker search. The keyboard stays on emoji. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Keep the search bar
patches_modified.description: Brings back the search bar at the top of your chat list when Messenger has swapped it for a search icon. Restart Messenger after changing it. If Messenger never gave you the icon, nothing changes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Keep unsent messages
patches_modified.description: Keeps messages on screen after someone unsends them, in chats where it works. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Mark as read button

Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Material You theme

patches_modified.name: Open settings from menu
patches_modified.description: Adds a HushMessenger entry to Messenger's Menu tab and side menu, and makes a long press on the Messenger logo at the top of Chats or on the Menu tab's title open these settings too. Works as soon as you patch it in. The settings App tab can turn off each way in, as long as one stays on.

patches_modified.name: Open web links externally
patches_modified.description: Opens web links (http and https) in your default browser instead of inside Messenger. Other link types work as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Open your gallery app
patches_modified.description: The gallery button in a chat opens your phone's own gallery app. One photo or video opens in Messenger's editor for that chat, ready to send. patches_modified.name: Pin more chats
patches_modified.description: Lets you pin chats past Messenger's limit and puts Pin back on chats that don't offer it. Pins past the limit stay on this phone, so they won't show on your other devices. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Put gallery picks in the chat
patches_modified.description: With Open your gallery app on, what you pick goes into the chat's message box the way Messenger's own gallery puts it there, instead of the editor or the Send to sheet. Nothing goes out until you tap Send. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Quiet incoming calls
patches_modified.description: Calls still come in, but Messenger doesn't ring, vibrate or pop the call up over your screen. The call waits in the notification shade with Answer and Decline. A call you miss still shows in the chat. Only chosen chats keeps this to the chats you pick, and every other call rings. If the Facebook app is on your phone, it can still ring for the same call. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Record calls
patches_modified.description: Adds a Record button over Messenger during a call. The call goes into one sound file in Recordings/Messenger Calls on your phone (Music/Messenger Calls on Android 10 and 11). While it's on, calls use Android's regular audio path instead of Messenger's own, and Messenger needs a restart after you change it. Messenger doesn't tell the other people, and recording laws differ from place to place, so get everyone's OK first. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Restore old emoji drawer
patches_modified.description: Turns off Meta's redesigned emoji keyboard, so you keep the earlier layout. Restart Messenger after changing it. If Meta never gave you the redesign, nothing changes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Restore screens on re-signed builds
patches_modified.description: Patching and signing Messenger yourself can break some of its screens. This makes Messenger's signature check pass again, including for a Facebook you patched with the same key, and lets Threads and Instagram video links open in a Threads or Instagram you patched yourself. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Save any story
patches_modified.description: Adds Save to the More options menu on other people's stories, so you can keep their photo or video on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Save button for voice messages
patches_modified.description: Adds Save voice message to the menu you get by holding a voice message, for saving just that one. It goes in the same folder as Save voice messages you play, and that switch can stay off. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Save voice messages you play
patches_modified.description: Each voice message you play is also saved to Recordings/Messenger (Music/Messenger on Android 10 and 11), so your file manager and other players can open it. Playing it again doesn't save another copy. Needs Android 10 or newer. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Search saved messages
patches_modified.description: Adds a button to a chat's search results that searches the messages saved on this phone, for old chats Messenger's own search finds nothing in. It works in chats that aren't end-to-end encrypted, and it can only find what the phone has loaded. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Send photos at original quality
patches_modified.description: With HD on, sends a JPEG photo at its full size instead of Messenger's smaller copy, so it stays sharp. Location is still removed. Photos over 20 MB are still made smaller. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Send videos without re-encoding
patches_modified.description: Sends a video as the original file instead of a recompressed copy, when Messenger allows it. Videos over 25 MB, edited videos and some formats are still compressed. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Slide chats in and out
patches_modified.description: Slides a chat in from the side when you open it and back out when you go back. Chat heads and bubbles keep their own animations. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
